court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Principal Sub Court, Ponneri, H.M.O.P.No.336 of 2021
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act. She also sought to declare her marriage as null and void. The respondent-husband is already attending proceedings in another case.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to establish sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: Though the respondent is served with notice, there is no representation for him either in person or through counsel.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to attend court proceedings due to geographical constraints can be a sufficient reason for transfer.
legal_principles.held: She is not in a position to travel about 75 kms from her residence.

outcome.final_order: H.M.O.P.No.336 of 2021 pending on the file of the Principal Sub Court, Ponneri shall stand withdrawn and the same is transferred to the file of the Sub Court, Tambaram.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on restitution of conjugal rights
assisting with nullity of marriage proceedings
